newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet looks at sale of Europe food units.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet looks at sale of Europe food units.

text.p: Grand Metropolitan Plc said it will consider offering for sale its remaining food businesses in the UK and continental Europe, following news of the sale of its Erasco food business in Germany to Campbell Soup Co.

These will include Shippams, Peter's Savoury Products, Memory Lane Cakes and Fleur de Lys in Britain, Hofmann-Menu and Goldstein in Germany, Brossard in France and Italy, Suzy and Desobry in Belgium and Driehoek in the Netherlands.
The combined sales of these businesses last year were 370 million stg with operating profit of 10 million and operating capital used of 129 million stg at September 30, 1995.
This does not include written-off goodwill of 207 million stg, said GrandMet in a statement.
The company plans to maintain a strong brand presence in Europe with its big international brands -- Pillsbury, Green Giant, Haagen-Dazs and Old El Paso.
"All of these brands are market leaders and they will be developed under a simplified business structure, with a much reduced cost base," said the company.
From October 1, GrandMet Foods Europe will be renamed Pillsbury Europe and its headquarters will be relocated to Uxbridge on the outskirts of London, from Paris.
